title: Honey Gloss Collagen Drops Hair Oil for Fine to Medium Hair

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Hair Oil > Hair Styling & Treatments > Hair

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Heat Protection✓ Good for: Frizz✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Increases Shine
What it is: An ultra-glossy, weightless oil for fine to medium hair powered by Mirsalehi Honey and collagen active to hydrate, plump, and boost shine.

Hair Texture: Straight, Wavy, Curly, and Coily

Hair Type: Fine and Medium

Hair Concerns:
- Shine
- Dryness
- Heat Protection

Key Benefits:
- Hydrates
- Adds glossy shine
- Visibly plumps

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey: Intensely hydrates and adds glossy shine.
- Bee Garden Oil Blend: Nourishes and smooths frizz.
- Collagen Active: Supports body and bounce.

What Else You Need to Know: This hair oil delivers shine fast while smoothing, hydrating, and plumping hair.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Before first use, remove the protective stopper.
-Hold the bottle upside down and press the base to dispense two to three drops* into your palm. *Recommended dosage: Start with two drops and add more as needed.
-Apply to damp or dry hair from mid-lengths to ends.

Five Ways to Gloss:
-Pre-styling: Before styling, apply to damp hair from mid-lengths to ends to protect against heat.
-Style finisher: After styling, apply to dry hair from mid-lengths to ends to hydrate, plump, and add glossy shine.
-Formula booster: Add a few drops to the Honey Gloss Ceramide Therapy Hair Mask (sold separately) to boost hydration and shine. Use hair mask as usual.
-Pre-shampoo: Apply five drops to dry hair from mid-lengths to ends. Allow to absorb for a minimum of 30 minutes and then wash hair as usual.
-On-the-go touchups: Apply to dry hair from mid-lengths to ends to control frizz, add bounce, and boost shine on the go.
Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey: Intensely hydrates and adds glossy shine.
-Bee Garden Oil Blend: Nourishes and smooths frizz.
-Collagen Active: Supports body and bounce.

Dimethicone, Disiloxane, Mel (Honey, Miel),* Isostearoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Propolis Cera (Propolis Wax, Cire de Propolis),* Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot Oil) Fruit Extract, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Magnolia Officinalis Bark Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Raphanus Sativus (Radish) Seed Extract, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Octyldodecanol, Octyldodecyl Oleate, Glucomannan, Trihydroxystearin, Parfum (Fragrance), Triethyl Citrate, Isostearic Acid, Copaifera Officinalis (Balsam Copaiba) Resin, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl p-Cresol, Beta-Caryophyllene,** Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil,** Coumarin,** Hexyl Cinnamal,** Limonene,** Linalool,** Linalyl Acetate,** Pinene.**

*Honey sourced from the Mirsalehi Bee Garden.
**Allergens.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
